Generates and applies bundle crank transactions for tip payment and block builder updates.

# Purpose
This file builds and updates bundle crank transactions for a tip payment system. It defines two base transaction layouts, `fd_bundle_crank_3_base` and `fd_bundle_crank_2_base`, which contain the instruction order, account index layout, program IDs, and fixed fields for two crank variants. The code fills in network-dependent and validator-dependent addresses at run time, derives program addresses with `fd_pubkey_find_program_address`, and keeps a map from account addresses to transaction account indexes so it can avoid duplicate accounts when it builds a transaction.

The main API functions are [`fd_bundle_crank_gen_init`](<#fd_bundle_crank_gen_init>), [`fd_bundle_crank_get_addresses`](<#fd_bundle_crank_get_addresses>), [`fd_bundle_crank_generate`](<#fd_bundle_crank_generate>), and [`fd_bundle_crank_apply`](<#fd_bundle_crank_apply>). [`fd_bundle_crank_gen_init`](<#fd_bundle_crank_gen_init>) sets up the generator state and precomputes account addresses and parsed transactions. [`fd_bundle_crank_get_addresses`](<#fd_bundle_crank_get_addresses>) returns the current tip payment config address and tip receiver for a given epoch, and [`fd_bundle_crank_generate`](<#fd_bundle_crank_generate>) creates the crank payload and transaction after checking the current tip payment config and adjusting account indexes for the requested update. [`fd_bundle_crank_apply`](<#fd_bundle_crank_apply>) writes the expected post-crank state into a tip payment config object. The file also uses a generated hash map from `fd_map.c` and SIMD support when `FD_HAS_AVX` is enabled.
